summary: Example rhaap:create-execution-environment step creating 'Custom EE' from quay.io/ansible/creator-ee:v0.16.0 with pull: missing and deleteIfExist: false.
questions: How do I set the image for an EE created by a self-service template?
Which pull policy does the example EE step use?

answer_card.title: rhaap:create-execution-environment example
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
steps:
  - id: create-ee
    name: Create Execution Environment
    action: rhaap:create-execution-environment
    input:
      token: ${{ parameters.AAP_TOKEN }}
      deleteIfExist: false
      values:
        environmentName: Custom EE
        environmentDescription: Execution environment with custom collections
        organization: ${{ parameters.organization }}
        image: quay.io/ansible/creator-ee:v0.16.0
        pull: missing
```
